title: Title + kneeling warrior
vo: ઇતિહાસના 5 સૌથી શક્તિશાળી માઇન્ડસેટના નિયમો,
visual: Paper stack on a wooden desk. Calligraphy heading with a flourish. A warrior kneels in the rain on a battlefield, hands on a planted sword; storm watercolor behind.
anim: Heading writes on; storm wash blooms; warrior is inked line by line, then watercolor bleeds in; rain falls; head lifts at 2.2s.
sound: Boom on frame 1 · thunder on the 2s beats · music bed starts

title: Warrior rises
vo: જે તમને ક્યારેય કોઈની સામે ઝૂકવા નહીં દે!
visual: The warrior stands tall, sword lowered, cape behind.
anim: Rises 120px with an ease-out; mud splash; slow push-in.
sound: Whoosh on the rise · thunder beat

title: Five scrolls, the fifth glows
vo: આમાંથી પાંચમો નિયમ તમારી આખી વિચારવાની રીત બદલી નાખશે.
visual: Five ancient scrolls stacked down the parchment.
anim: Scrolls unroll one by one (every 0.3s); violet glow wash; the 5th scroll pulses gold as the voice says "fifth rule".
sound: Paper rustle beats · sparkle on the glow

title: Fire padlock "5"
vo: એટલે અંત સુધી ધ્યાનથી સાંભળજો.
visual: A golden padlock marked 5 sits on the 5th scroll, wrapped in flames.
anim: Padlock pops in, flames flicker, then it swells and bursts into sparks; white flash.
sound: Whoosh in · boom + sparkle on the burst

title: Glowing 1
vo: નિયમ 1:
visual: Clean paper. Heading with underline. Big blue-glowing 1 in blue flames.
anim: Heading writes on; the 1 pops in, flickers, shrinks away.

title: Alexander the Great
vo: એલેક્ઝાન્ડર ધ ગ્રેટ
visual: Ink-and-wash bust in a crested Macedonian helmet and armour, name caption below.
anim: Pen draws the portrait, washes bleed in, caption writes on; slow push-in.

title: Dream big
vo: સપનાં હંમેશાં મોટાં જુઓ,
visual: A young traveller looks up at a giant hatched mountain; a small staircase starts toward it.
anim: Mountain, man, then stairs draw in; slow drift.

title: Small steps every day
vo: પરંતુ એને પૂરાં કરવા માટે દરરોજ નાનાં-નાનાં પગલાં ભરો.
visual: The traveller, full body, climbs the stairs.
anim: Climbs step by step with a walking bob.

title: Overnight success: crossed out
vo: કારણ કે રાતોરાત સફળતા મળવાની વાત માત્ર એક ભ્રમ છે.
visual: A vintage certificate reading OVERNIGHT SUCCESS with a gold seal, ink splatter around.
anim: Certificate pops in; a red ink X slashes across it; shake; it falls away.

title: Summit
vo: (pause)
visual: Brick staircase up to the peak, tiny figure on top, clouds and birds.
anim: Bricks draw bottom to top; camera eases out.

title: Electric 2
vo: નિયમ 2:
visual: Two-line heading; neon outline 2 crackling with lightning.
anim: Heading writes on; 2 pops and flickers.

title: Napoleon, hourglass, chess
vo: નેપોલિયન બોનાપાર્ટ — સાચી જીત હંમેશાં એ વ્યક્તિની થાય છે,
visual: Napoleon in bicorne and uniform with name caption; hourglass on the right; perspective chessboard.
anim: Portrait inks in, caption writes; hourglass draws and sand starts falling (until the end of the rule); board draws.

title: The patient move
vo: જે સૌથી વધુ ધીરજ રાખે છે
visual: A hand reaches in and moves a knight forward.
anim: Hand slides in, lifts and places the piece, slides out.

title: Calm in the storm
vo: અને ખરાબ સમય માટે પહેલેથી જ તૈયાર રહે છે.
visual: Storm clouds, lightning, enemies charging; an armoured warrior stands calm with his shield beside the hourglass; blue arcs over the board.
anim: Storm wash in; lightning flickers; warrior inks in; blue arcs trace across the board.

title: Blueprint 3
vo: નિયમ 3:
visual: Construction guides and a hatched serif 3.
anim: Guides draw; the 3 reveals top to bottom.

title: Julius Caesar
vo: જુલિયસ સીઝર
visual: Marble bust with laurel crown and toga, name caption.
anim: Quick ink-in, washes, caption.

title: Fear of failure (glass head)
vo: જે દિવસે તમે તમારા મનમાંથી હારવાનો ડર સંપૂર્ણપણે કાઢી નાખશો,
visual: A side-profile head of black glass with FEAR of FAILURE written inside.
anim: Slow push-in; white cracks spread across it from 31.6s; it trembles.

title: Shatter
vo: એ જ દિવસે…
visual: The glass head breaks into shards.
anim: Shards fly outward, spin and fall.

title: Victory trophy
vo: …તમે અડધી જંગ જીતી જશો. પરંતુ અસલી રહસ્ય તો આગળ છે!
visual: A Roman warrior with glowing eyes raises a golden trophy in a smoky arena; crowd and banners behind.
anim: Walks toward camera (92% → 105%); dust rises.

title: Slash
vo: નિયમ 4:
visual: A single glowing blue slash.
anim: Blue flash; slash grows and fades.

title: Miyamoto Musashi
vo: મહાન યોદ્ધા મિયામોટો મુસાશી
visual: Samurai with topknot and gi holding a katana; name caption.
anim: Inks in; katana snaps up with a blue glint and dotted cut arc.

title: One bright path
vo: એકવાર તમે તમારો રસ્તો સમજી લો, પછી દરેક મુશ્કેલ કામ સરળ લાગવા લાગે છે.
visual: The samurai (profile) faces a tangle of confusing roads; one blue illuminated path cuts straight through.
anim: Roads draw; beam reveals bottom to top with a star flare; profile moves closer.
sound: Whoosh beats · sparkle on the beam

title: Distractions, then fog
vo: બસ, તમારું ધ્યાન ક્યારેય લક્ષ્યથી ભટકવું જોઈએ નહીં.
visual: Scribbles, #!?, spirals and comic bursts crowd him; grey fog rolls in.
anim: Doodles pop and jitter; fog sweeps them away.

title: Intense eyes
vo: (pause)
visual: Extreme close-up of the determined samurai.
anim: Slow push-in; eyes ignite blue with a lens flare.

title: Pen stroke
vo: નિયમ 5:
visual: A rough blue ballpoint stroke.
anim: Stroke draws in, fades.

title: Marcus Aurelius with sculpture
vo: માર્કસ ઓરેલિયસ
visual: Bearded philosopher in a dark robe holding a small classical marble bust; purple-blue watercolor aura; name caption.
anim: Aura wash blooms; portrait inks in; caption writes.

title: Anger, fear, doubt
vo: જે વ્યક્તિ પોતાના ગુસ્સા, ડર અને ભટકતા વિચારો પર નિયંત્રણ મેળવી લે છે,
visual: His face darkens and turns angry; handwritten anger, fear, doubt and scribbles swirl around.
anim: Brightness drops to 45%; shake; words swirl, then blow away.

title: Unshakable
vo: તેને હરાવવી દુનિયા માટે મુશ્કેલ બની જાય છે.
visual: Calm again, eyes closed; a glowing aura; arrows fly in from every side.
anim: Aura blooms and pulses; arrows hit the aura and bounce off.
sound: Clicks as each arrow deflects · riser

title: Golden light: UNDEFEATABLE
vo: યાદ રાખજો, સૌથી મોટી જીત બીજાઓ પર નહીં, પરંતુ પોતાના મન પર મેળવવાની હોય છે.
visual: Eyes closed peacefully; warm golden light behind; bold UNDEFEATABLE across the top; golden dust.
anim: Gold flash; light blooms; letters stamp down one by one; dust floats up; slow push-in.
sound: Stamp on every letter · shimmer beats

title: Golden SUBSCRIBE
vo: આવી જ શક્તિશાળી વાતો માટે પેજને ફોલો કરો અને સબ્સ્ક્રાઇબ કરો!
visual: A golden SUBSCRIBE button with a pointing hand.
anim: Button pops in; the hand taps it; gold rays burst and rotate; sparks fly out continuously.
sound: Click + boom on the tap · sparkle · music fades
